Up to 70% of the OddsJam 2026 amount can be settled in shares, which would be heavily dilutive at $0.74. The share price has been below $1 since about early November. A Nasdaq minimum-bid deficiency notice needs 30 consecutive business days below $1, so it lands after the window.
